name: STT Plugin
description: Speech-to-Text gateway plugin. Transcribes base64 audio via a named STT provider config and forwards the result to the specified session.

select.description: Default config name to use when configName is not specified in stt.send.

type.description: STT provider type. Determines the API request format. Supported: openai, aliyun.

apikey.description: API key for the STT provider.

url.description: Optional custom STT endpoint URL. Defaults per type: openai uses OpenAI Whisper API, aliyun uses DashScope chat completions.

model.description: Model name to use. Defaults to whisper-1 for openai and qwen-asr-flash for aliyun.

configs.description: Map of named STT configs. Each key is a config name; value contains apikey and an optional url override.

configSchema.description: STT plugin config. Use select to set a default config name, and configs to define named STT provider entries.
